ne6c37c73c1.headline: Volaris reports 81.7% YoY decrease in Q2 2020 revenues
ne6c37c73c1.summary: Volaris reported total operating revenues of Ps.1,526 million in Q2 2020, down 81.7% year over year amid the COVID-19 pandemic's impact on air travel.
ne6c37c73c1.why: Volaris is a key player in Mexico's aviation market, and its sharp revenue decline highlights the severe disruption to the airline industry caused by the pandemic.
ne6c37c73c1.why_moved: The steep revenue drop signals ongoing financial stress in the airline sector due to COVID-19 travel restrictions.

ne8b5031e32.headline: Singapore Airlines reports S$1.12 billion net loss in Q1 as COVID-19 hits demand
ne8b5031e32.summary: Singapore Airlines posted a net loss of S$1.12 billion in Q1 after drastically cutting capacity due to COVID-19 travel restrictions, compared to a S$111 million profit a year earlier.
ne8b5031e32.why: Singapore Airlines is a major global airline and its financial results reflect the severe impact of the pandemic on international air travel and the broader aviation sector.

impacts.name: Singapore Airlines
impacts.why: Large net loss due to COVID-19 travel restrictions signals financial stress.
